title: Tone strip and drawing frame sheet
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 2: Observational drawing and a memory box (Memory Box)
source: Written for art/y1 lesson 6 (Tone strip and drawing frame sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 6: Drawing a treasured object. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A mug with light and dark tones

blocks.text: Press lightly for the first box and harder for each one after.

box.title: Draw your object here and shade it using your tones

keywords.def: the line round the edge of a shape
colour in with a pencil to show dark parts
how light or dark something is

questions.q: Make a tone strip: five boxes, light to dark.
Where does the light shine on your object?
questions.a: For example: the top of the cup

questions.q: Core: Draw your treasured object. Outline, details, then shading.
questions.a: A drawing with an outline and two or more tones

questions.q: Extend: Use a soft pencil (2B) for the darkest parts.
Stretch: Write why the object is special.
questions.a: For example: My grandad's watch reminds us of him

questions.q: To make a dark tone, press:
questions.a: B) Harder. Pressing harder puts more pencil on the paper, so it looks darker.

questions.q: Big question: how can a pencil make something look shiny?
questions.a: Leave white paper for the shine and shade the dark parts
